rows.registerTitle: Trellis.2 and Pixal3D as CORE ComfyUI nodes - local image-to-3D with a full PBR bake
rows.canonical: Canonical:** `comfyanonymous/ComfyUI` @ `0e65cb907193cf1013bda474593eb48d8c53d848` (the merge commit of PR #14718 "feat: Support Pixal3d and TRELLIS2", merged 2026-08-22T00:32Z into `master`; shipped in release **v0.34.0**, which is the version installed here). Upstream generators: `microsoft/TRELLIS.2` @ `75fbf0183001ed9876c8dbb35de6b68552ee08bd` and `TencentARC/Pixal3D` @ `f7cf38429b0bd264f1995f0f8743a88b1c728b94` (SIGGRAPH 2026, "Pixel-Aligned 3D Generation from Images").
rows.licence: Licence:** CLEAR for the generators, with one **observed-vs-claimed discrepancy that the announcement's own wording hides**. Read as files on 2026-09-02, not from SPDX fields: `microsoft/TRELLIS.2/LICENSE` is MIT (c) Microsoft Corporation; `TencentARC/Pixal3D/LICENSE` (GitHub `master`, and a real `LICENSE` file in the HF weights repo too) is MIT (c) 2026 Tencent with **no non-commercial or jurisdiction clause**; that repo's `NOTICE` names dinov2 (Apache-2.0), TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft), Direct3D-S2 (MIT, DreamTech) and MoGe (MIT, Microsoft). MoGe's Comfy-Org repackage carries a real MIT+Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` file. **The discrepancy:** the three Comfy-Org repackaged repos actually used by the workflow - `Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2` @ `463441b1c32829ee876e4f297dcfff533cb357a7`, `Comfy-Org/Pixal3D` @ `b35ffffa61fa02a86c377d94b755d9fe65d185d9`, `Comfy-Org/BiRefNet` @ `5a1bd8ae750548f8cd42e3c8afa854fd3eba0fb1` - contain **no LICENSE file whatsoever**; MIT is only a model-card metadata field, i.e. a claim about a bundle. And the required image encoder `dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors` is a **DINOv3** backbone (Meta's custom DINOv3 License: commercial use permitted, but with an attribution condition and redistribution terms, and explicitly not Apache/MIT - DINOv2 was Apache-2.0, DINOv3 is not) with a NAF upsampler vendored from `valeoai/NAF` (Apache-2.0, credited in `comfy/image_encoders/naf.py`). So "no non-commercial license traps" is TRUE; "it's all MIT" is NOT. If anything generated by this route ships publicly, clear the DINOv3 attribution condition with the owner first.
rows.decision: Decision:** ADOPT as the executable form of the "AI-generated mesh" supply route in `ai-3d-asset-generation-loop` - free, local, commercially usable, no paid API, one bounded prop at a time. It does **not** relax any existing boundary: image-to-3D still invents hidden geometry and still produces an unrigged shell, so it is for **static hero props only**, never characters, never first-person arms, never rigged or deforming geometry, and never in preference to a procedural rebuild for terrain, architecture, repeated dressing or anything needing colliders and destruction groups. Atomic Acres remains procedural-art-first: a generated mesh is a per-asset owner exception carried by `assets.manifest.json` and `qa:asset-provenance`, not a general licence to import geometry. ComfyUI's own `Preview3D` is never acceptance evidence. Do not update, restart or queue work on the owner's ComfyUI beyond a single authorised bounded test with an idle queue.
